message: 天のことのは
Lately, the demons have been getting stronger. Instead of charging in alone with brute force, they've started coordinating attacks with their allies.
While there are types like Sally-chan and the Delicious Food Squad who will listen to what we have to say, the ones who won't are increasing.
What am I supposed to do from here on out?

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun. It is still far too early for you to walk with your head in the clouds.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good afternoon.」
Walking along lost in thought, I arrive at the plaza on the hill.
Why did I end up coming here? Was I subconsciously aiming for Finis Tower at the edge of my vision, or simply because it's the center of the academy?

name: Melilot
message: 「Deep contemplation is important, but if you are merely going around in circles, please look firmly ahead as you walk.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahead... u-whoa!?」
Before I knew it, I had strayed from the promenade and stepped into the tall grass.
At my feet, barely thirty centimeters past the tips of my toes, stands a grave marker made from a popsicle stick.

name: Melilot
message: 「No matter what form it takes, a burial ground is a sacred place. One must not trample over it carelessly.」

name: Synn
message: 「J-Just barely safe!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe.」
Right near Finis Tower, in this secluded patch of grass out of sight, there's a section that the children of Ryuusei Town have taken to using as a pet cemetery.
Wherever they've made their secret shortcuts, they use that keen intuition unique to kids to sneak onto the grounds of Ryuusei Academy and hold burials without permission.
Since there aren't very many of them, it's never become an issue through complaints to the Student Council, and it seems Helena-san and Melilot-san quietly turn a blind eye to it as well.

name: Melilot
message: 「The morning dew of a chilly dawn clings to its fur. It must be cold.」
The grass in front of Melilot-san is unnaturally raised in a small mound. One of the crude graves.
On the kamaboko board grave marker, mirrored hiragana characters are written--clearly by the hand of a very young child.
Looking closely, part of the dirt mound has collapsed.
A little child must have come here, dug a grave, and buried their beloved pet, only to fall just a tiny bit short in strength.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's cover it back up with dirt.」
I step up beside Melilot-san.
Offered at the grave were flowers arranged in a milk bottle.
The water inside the bottle has completely evaporated, and the flowers have withered and dried up.
It seems the child who used to be its owner hasn't visited in a very long time.
I scoop up some nearby soil and quickly sprinkle a thin layer over the exposed fur to cover it up.

name: Melilot
message: 「Why do the children come here to bury their deceased pets, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, maybe they don't have yards at their houses?」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, if it is merely a matter of open ground, there is also Mihoshizaka Park.」

name: Synn
message: 「They wouldn't be able to sleep peacefully in a place where everyone is playing and running around.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, this is right at the base of Finis Tower.」

name: Synn
message: 「You can see the tower from anywhere in Ryuusei Town. If they look at the tower, they can see their departed pets anytime... Isn't that how it is?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I see. That is an intriguing way of thinking.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Running freely across fields and mountains alongside their masters, and at the end, welcoming a time of peace in this place where Finis Tower can be seen. Yet neither the people nor the hearts they miss can be sought any longer.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Perhaps that tower reaches all the way up to the heavens.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If so, it would hardly be unreasonable to think that angels might descend along the tower.」

name: Melilot
message: 「True to their name, angels are faint, delicate beings--messengers who deliver words from heaven, from the beyond to this side.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heart-stirring messages, sorrowful messages, encouraging messages... I wonder what sort of words this little one received?」
Melilot-san cupped some soil in both palms, warming it with her own body heat, and let it fall onto the grave.
I nodded silently. What else could I possibly have done?
